plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Virtual-team operating model: a CTO/lead supervises on-demand specialists (builder/reviewer/researcher), runs bounded sequential sprints, and gates every change on top of an elevated adversarial reviewer. Project-agnostic — domain knowledge stays in per-project area skills.

plugins.name: paseo-cto
plugins.description: CTO over an external Paseo agent fleet (Codex/GPT, Claude, ...): machine-checkable task hand-outs, execution-verified one-line review verdicts, CTO-owned integration serialized against live runs, 10-minute self-check cycle, idle-minimized fleet. The cross-provider sibling of the team plugin.
